name: email-domain-reputation
description: Client email domain health audit for IT providers: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, DNSSEC, DNS blocklists, registration expiry, and a pasted test message's verdict, with severity-ranked findings and DNS fixes. Also evidence-led triage of one inbound address via AbstractAPI. Local MCP server, OS-keychain credentials, and keyless DNS-only domain audits.
